title: Navigation conformance fixture
description: Executable spec for route resolution. Every Orca SDK (Flutter, Swift, Kotlin) loads these files, builds its route table from `config`, seeds app state from `config.initialAppState` with `appState` laid over it, resolves each case's `location` as a `go` (replace) navigation and asserts `expected`. The Flutter SDK is the oracle: an expected value is what its real router shows. A file may also carry `sessions` (beside `cases` or instead of them): each session boots a fresh app at `config.initialRoute` with the seeded app state (the file-level `appState` overlay is for `cases` only), then runs its steps in order on that one app. What the SDK shows is asserted after the boot (`boot.expected`) and after every step (`expected`). A file may instead carry `links` alone: each link case hands one URL to a fresh app, warm (the app shows `startAt`) or cold (the URL opened the app), and asserts where the app ends up and what the deep link callback receives. Native SDKs must match a link's `expected` exactly; `flutter` lists where the Flutter SDK is known to differ.

appState.description: Laid over `config.initialAppState` key by key, after the seed and before any case is resolved.

Config.description: A GET /api/v1/app/:appId/config body as the engine serves it (core/app.ts getNavConfig).

initialRoute.description: With a leading slash, e.g. `/home`. Must resolve to a page with the seeded state.

pages.description: Pre-rendered page responses of a static flow, keyed by page path.

Route.description: One route as core/flow.ts collectRouteInfo emits it.

path.description: No leading slash; `:name` is a param segment. A child carries its full path (`home/product/:id`).

equals.description: The redirect applies while appState[when] equals this value.

to.description: Target location, with a leading slash.

location.description: The location asked for, with a leading slash and an optional query.

kind.description: `page`: a page is shown and requested. `error`: the router's not-found screen, no page request.

location.description: Final location after the redirect, query included when it survives.

redirected.description: True when the final location's path differs from the asked one's.

pagePath.description: Page request path of the top page: the final location without its leading slash and query.

routePath.description: Full matched pattern with a leading slash, e.g. `/home/product/:id`.

params.description: Path params of every matched level.

stack.description: Page request paths bottom to top after a `go`: the parent chain of a nested route, then the page itself.

tabIndex.description: Index into config.tabs of the tab that shows the page; null without tabs and for a route outside every tab.

scaffoldTitle.description: Fallback title of the title bar a non-tab route is wrapped in (the page's own title wins once loaded); null when the page is not wrapped.

appState.description: Optional: the whole app state at resolve time.

Session.description: One run of a booted app. The boot is not a step: the app starts at `config.initialRoute` and `boot.expected` pins what is shown then, so the boot's page requests (the initial route's page) and the first `_tabIndex` write are accounted for there and never in the first step.

Step.description: One operation and what is shown once it has settled.

location.description: A location with a leading slash.

oneOf.description: Push a location over what is shown (GoRouter.push).

location.description: A location with a leading slash.

oneOf.description: Pop the top page (GoRouter.pop). Never written where there is nothing to pop: at a tab root Flutter's router throws and the platform's back leaves the app.
A tap on the item at `index` of the default tab bar. Only written while the bar is on screen.
The `switchTab` action run by the action executor from the page on screen.
One key written into app state through the state manager.

Observed.description: What the SDK shows after the boot or after a step. All four keys are always present.

location.description: The visible location: the one of the page on top, also when it was pushed.

tabIndex.description: The tab shell's current index while a shell exists, also under a route pushed over it; null when there is no shell (after a `go` to a route outside the tabs).

appState.description: A subset of app state: every key listed is compared, other keys are not looked at. Carries `_tabIndex`.

pageRequests.description: Page request paths (no leading slash) made during the boot or during this step, in order; empty when nothing is fetched.

Link.description: One link handed to a fresh app. The app boots with `config.initialAppState` and the case's `appState` laid over it.

link.description: The URL as the platform delivers it: any scheme, any host, or a bare path.

coldStart.description: True: the link opened the app, which starts at the link's location instead of `config.initialRoute`. False: the link reaches a running app that shows `startAt`.

startAt.description: Warm links only: the location the app shows when the link arrives (reached with a `go` after the boot). Default: `config.initialRoute`.

appState.description: Laid over `config.initialAppState` key by key before the app starts.

LinkExpected.description: What a native SDK shows and reports once the link has settled. All seven keys are always present.

kind.description: `page`: a page is shown. `error`: the router's not-found screen, no page request.

location.description: The final location, after the redirect: path and query, nothing else. Scheme, host and fragment are dropped, an empty path is `/`, a trailing slash is dropped.

redirected.description: True when the final location's path differs from the path of the link's location.

stack.description: Page request paths bottom to top, as after a `go`; empty for kind `error`.

tabIndex.description: Index into config.tabs of the tab that shows the page; null for a route outside every tab and for kind `error`.

pageRequests.description: Page request paths (no leading slash) made because of the link, in order. Cold: every request since the app started. Warm: the ones the link adds to what `startAt` had already fetched.

event.description: What the deep link callback receives, once, after the navigation and after the route change callback; null when the callback must not be called.

resolvedLocation.description: The final location, after the redirect: path and query.

pathParameters.description: Path params of every matched level of the final location; empty on the not-found route.

queryParameters.description: Query parameters of the final location.

wasRedirected.description: True when the final location's path differs from the path of the link as it was given, before a trailing slash is dropped or an empty path becomes `/`.

isColdStart.description: True when the link is what opened the app; equals the case's `coldStart`.

LinkFlutter.description: Values of `expected` that the Flutter SDK is known to report differently. The Flutter runner holds Flutter to `expected` with these laid over it; native SDKs ignore this object.

why.description: The documented Flutter quirk behind the difference (README, Links).

event.description: null: Flutter does not call the callback. An object: the event keys Flutter reports differently, the others as in `expected.event`.
